# Hondo v0.1.0

Hondo v0.1.0 is the first usable release of the terminal-native SolidJS framework.

## Highlights

- Solid 2 fine-grained renderer through `@solidjs/universal`
- embedded QuickJS application runtime with a Zig host bridge
- terminal lifecycle, Unicode/grapheme-safe cell rendering and incremental ANSI diffing
- Linux/macOS PTY and Windows ConPTY integration coverage
- native layout primitives and editor-quality reusable controls
- typed terminal-native styling with tokens and composition
- keyboard focus traversal, mouse hit testing, capture/target/bubble events and overlays
- `NativeView` registration, measurement, painting, invalidation, lifecycle and direct native input
- proof that 10,000 handled NativeView key events can remain in Zig without the JS node dispatcher
- buildable `@hondo/core` and `@hondo/solid` ESM package artifacts with declarations

## Package artifacts

The GitHub release attaches npm-compatible tarballs for:

- `@hondo/core@0.1.0`
- `@hondo/solid@0.1.0`

Both packages target ES2022. `@hondo/solid` is pinned to Solid 2 RC.4 for v0.1.0.

## Compatibility

Supported development/runtime matrix:

- Zig 0.16.0
- Node >= 22.12.0 (CI: Node 24)
- npm 12.0.2
- TypeScript 5.9.2
- `solid-js` 2.0.0-rc.4
- `@solidjs/universal` 2.0.0-rc.4
- Ubuntu, macOS and Windows terminals covered by PTY/ConPTY lifecycle smoke tests

See `docs/compatibility.md` for the full compatibility contract.

## API status

v0.1.0 establishes the first public API for primitives, styling, controls, focus/events and NativeView. Hondo follows Semantic Versioning after this release, but 0.x may still contain breaking API evolution; such changes will be explicitly documented.

## Known release dependency

The project-level M8 release criterion requires an external Zim integration proof. Hondo itself remains independent of Zim; the proof belongs primarily in the Zim repository and validates Hondo as a real consumer dependency.
